verdict.rationale: Decagon is an AI agent platform, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is a blog post that discusses MCP in general terms ('a standard way to package and expose tools') and the need for an infrastructure layer to curate tools. Neither quote states that Decagon agents can connect to or consume external MCP servers, so there is no affirmative evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
